          Live At Dekmantel, Amsterdam 2026 01:00:52

          about

          We don’t play live that often these days, choosing the studio over airports, but it’s great to get out and play every now and then.

          We had a great time at Dekmantel, and it was fantastic to hear the tracks over such a large system. There’s something about hearing music you’ve spent months making in the studio suddenly filling a space that makes all the travelling worthwhile.

          Every year, we try to give something back to our community, and this album is our gift to you. A small thank you for all the support throughout 2026. It’s been a wicked creative year for us, and we’ve got plenty more music on the way.

          Thanks for listening, buying the records, coming to the shows and sticking with us.

          tBd • 353
